Abiding Hex.text: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

Accelerated Growth.text: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.

Accelerated Growth II.text: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.

Acrimony.text: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Adhesive Grenades I.text: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

Adhesive Grenades II.text: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.

Admixture.text: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.

Advancing Storm.text: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.

Aftershock I.text: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

Aftershock II.text: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

Ahn's Citadel.text: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.

Ailith's Chimes.text: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.

Alignment I.text: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Alignment II.text: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Alignment III.text: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Amanamu's Tithe.text: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.

Ambrosia.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

Ambrosia II.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

Ambush.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.

Ammo Conservation I.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

Ammo Conservation II.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

Ammo Conservation III.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.

Ancestral Aid.text: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.

Ancestral Call I.text: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Ancestral Call II.text: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Arakaali's Lust.text: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.

Arbiter's Ignition.text: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.

Arcane Surge.text: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.

Arjun's Medal.text: Supports Crossbow Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all Crossbow Ammunition on kill.

Armour Break I.text: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

Armour Break II.text: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

Armour Break III.text: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

Armour Demolisher I.text: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

Armour Demolisher II.text: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

Armour Explosion.text: Supports Attacks and Warcries, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.

Arms Length.text: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.

Astral Projection.text: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.

Atalui's Bloodletting.text: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.

Atziri's Allure.text: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.

Atziri's Communion.text: Supports Persistent Skills, making them Reserve Life instead of Spirit. Cannot Support Skills which create Minions.

Atziri's Impatience.text: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.

Auto Reload.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Barbs I.text: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Barbs II.text: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Barbs III.text: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage twice to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Battershout.text: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.

Behead I.text: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.

Behead II.text: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.

Bhatair's Vengeance.text: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.

Bidding I.text: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Bidding II.text: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Bidding III.text: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Biting Frost I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Biting Frost II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze, leaving them Chilled. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Blazing Critical.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.

Bleed I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

Bleed II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

Bleed III.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.

Bleed IV.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.

Blind I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.

Blind II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.

Blindside.text: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.

Bloodlust.text: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.

Bone Shrapnel.text: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.

Boundless Energy I.text: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

Boundless Energy II.text: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

Bounty I.text: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

Bounty II.text: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

Brambleslam.text: Supports Slam Skills, making them Trigger Brambles to create Hazardous brambles which damage and Maim enemies. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.

Branching Fissures I.text: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

Branching Fissures II.text: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

Brink I.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.

Brink II.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.

Brittle Armour.text: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.

Brutality I.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

Brutality II.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

Brutality III.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.

Brutus' Brain.text: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Burgeon I.text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

Burgeon II.text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

Burning Inscription.text: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.

Bursting Plague.text: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

Cadence.text: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.

Caltrops.text: Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.

Cannibalism I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

Cannibalism II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

Catalysing Elements.text: Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.

Catharsis.text: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.

Chain I.text: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Chain II.text: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Chain III.text: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Chaos Attunement.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.

Chaos Mastery.text: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Chaotic Freeze.text: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Charge Profusion I.text: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.

Charge Profusion II.text: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.

Charged Mark.text: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.

Charged Shots I.text: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

Charged Shots II.text: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

Charm Bounty.text: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.

Cirel's Cultivation.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Clarity I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Clarity II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Clash.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.

Close Combat I.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

Close Combat II.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

Cold Attunement.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.

Cold Exposure.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when it inflicts Freeze.

Cold Mastery.text: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Cold Penetration.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

Combo Finisher I.text: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

Combo Finisher II.text: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

Commandment.text: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.

Commiserate.text: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.

Compressed Duration I.text: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

Compressed Duration II.text: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

Concentrated Area.text: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.

Concoct I.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

Concoct II.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

Concussive Spells.text: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.

Considered Casting.text: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.

Controlled Destruction.text: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

Controlled Hazard.text: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.

Cool Headed.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Cooldown Recovery I.text: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

Cooldown Recovery II.text: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

Corpse Conservation.text: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.

Corrosion.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.

Corrupting Cry I.text: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

Corrupting Cry II.text: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

Coursing Current.text: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.

Crackling Barrier.text: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.

Crater.text: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Crazed Minions.text: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.

Creeping Chill.text: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.

Crescendo I.text: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.

Crescendo II.text: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.

Crescendo III.text: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.

Crystalline Shards.text: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.

Culling Strike I.text: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.

Culling Strike II.text: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.

Culmination I.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Culmination II.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Cursed Ground.text: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.

Danse Macabre.text: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.

Daresso's Passion.text: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.

Dauntless.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.

Daze.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

Deadly Herald.text: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.

Deadly Poison I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

Deadly Poison II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

Deadly Resolve.text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.

Deathmarch.text: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.

Decaying Hex.text: Supports Curse skills. Supported skill Trigger Profane Decay on each target they curse to inflict a damaging Debuff.

Deep Cuts I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

Deep Cuts II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

Deep Freeze.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.

Defy I.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.

Defy II.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.

Delayed Gratification.text: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.

Delayed Reaction.text: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.

Deliberation.text: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.

Derange.text: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

Dialla's Desire.text: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.

Direstrike I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

Direstrike II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

Doedre's Undoing.text: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Skills create an area which Curses Enemies within it, and spawns Witchtoads in that area. Witchtoads leap at enemies that get close, and seek out Cursed enemies with higher aggression. Dark Consequences will be Triggered when they hit enemies with their leap, violently exploding the Witchtoad.

Dominus' Grasp.text: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.

Double Barrel I.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

Double Barrel II.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

Double Barrel III.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Drain Ailments.text: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.

Durability.text: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Echoing Cry.text: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.

Efficiency I.text: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

Efficiency II.text: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

Einhar's Beastrite.text: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Electrocute.text: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.

Electromagnetism.text: Supports Skills that Hit enemies. When Supported Skills Shock an enemy that is nearby other Shocked enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, Hindering them, and dealing Lightning damage at an interval.

Elemental Armament I.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

Elemental Armament II.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

Elemental Armament III.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they Hit. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

Elemental Army.text: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Elemental Discharge.text: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions or skills which already Consume Elemental Ailments.

Elemental Focus.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.

Embitter.text: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.

Empowered Sparks I.text: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

Encroaching Ground.text: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.

Enduring Impact I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

Enduring Impact II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

Energy Capacitor.text: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.

Energy Retention.text: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.

Enraged Warcry I.text: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

Enraged Warcry II.text: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

Eonyr's Thunder.text: Supports any Skill which can deal damage. Lightning damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock. Enemies slain while Electrocuted by Supported Skills explode, dealing a percentage of their maximum Life as Lightning damage.

Escalating Poison.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.

Esh's Radiance.text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.

Essence Harvest.text: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.

Eternal Flame I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.

Eternal Flame II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.

Eternal Flame III.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.

Eternal Mark.text: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.

Excise.text: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Execrate.text: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Execute I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

Execute II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

Execute III.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

Expand.text: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Expanse.text: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Exploit Weakness.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

Exposing Cry.text: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.

Extraction.text: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.

Fan The Flames.text: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.

Fan The Flames II.text: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.

Feeding Frenzy I.text: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Ferocity.text: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do, but cannot generate Frenzy Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Frenzy Charges.

Fiery Death.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.

Fire Attunement.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.

Fire Exposure.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when Igniting.

Fire Mastery.text: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Fire Penetration I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.

Fire Penetration II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.

Fist of War I.text: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

Fist of War II.text: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

Fist of War III.text: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.

Flamepierce.text: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.

Fluke.text: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

Focused Curse.text: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.

Font of Blood.text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.

Font of Mana.text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.

Fork.text: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.

Fortress I.text: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.

Fortress II.text: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.

Freeze.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.

Freezefork.text: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.

Frenzied Riposte.text: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.

Fresh Clip I.text: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.

Fresh Clip II.text: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.

Frost Nexus.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.

Frostfire.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Freeze on Igniting a Frozen enemy to boost the effect of the Ignite. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze or Ignite.

Frozen Spite.text: Supports Skills that Hit enemies, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Gambleshot.text: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.

Garukhan's Resolve.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.

Glacier.text: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

Gorge.text: Supports skills that consume Corpses. Consuming Corpses with supported skills grants Flask charges.

Guatelitzi's Ablation.text: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

Haemocrystals.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.

Hardy Totems I.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

Hardy Totems II.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

Harmonic Remnants I.text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

Harmonic Remnants II.text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.

Hayoxi's Fulmination.text: Supports Curse Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.

Heavy Swing.text: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.

Heft.text: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.

Heightened Accuracy I.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.

Heightened Accuracy II.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.

Heightened Charges.text: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.

Heightened Curse.text: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.

Helbrym's Hide.text: Supports Shapeshifting Skills, causing them to grant Helbrym's Composure for a brief duration when they cause you to Shapeshift. Shapeshifting into a different form before the Buff expires causes it to be removed without effect.

Herbalism I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

Herbalism II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

Hex Bloom.text: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.

Hit and Run.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.

Holy Descent.text: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.

Hourglass.text: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Hulking Minions.text: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.

Ice Bite I.text: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

Ice Bite II.text: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

Icicle.text: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.

Ignite I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

Ignite II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

Ignite III.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.

Immolate.text: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.

Impact Shockwave.text: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Impale.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.

Impending Doom.text: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.

Incision.text: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.

Inexorable Critical I.text: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.

Inexorable Critical II.text: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.

Infernal Legion I.text: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Infernal Legion II.text: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Infernal Legion III.text: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Inhibitor.text: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.

Innervate.text: Supports damaging skills you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills imbues your damage with Lightning damage for a short time.

Intense Agony.text: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.

Ixchel's Torment.text: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

Jagged Ground I.text: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.

Jagged Ground II.text: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.

Kalisa's Crescendo.text: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.

Kaom's Madness.text: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.

Khatal's Rejuvenation.text: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.

Knockback.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.

Kulemak's Dominion.text: Supports Offering Skills, causing your Cascadable Spells to Cascade to the locations of Supported Offerings.

Kurgal's Leash.text: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.

Last Gasp.text: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration.

Lasting Ground.text: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.

Lasting Shock.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.

Life Bounty.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Life Flask charges.

Life Drain.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.

Life Leech I.text: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

Life Leech II.text: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

Life Leech III.text: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.

Lifetap.text: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.

Lightning Attunement.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.

Lightning Exposure.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when inflicting Shock.

Lightning Mastery.text: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Lightning Penetration.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.

Living Lightning.text: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Living Lightning II.text: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Lockdown.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.

Long Fuse I.text: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

Long Fuse II.text: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

Longshot I.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

Longshot II.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

Loyalty.text: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

Magnetic Remnants.text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

Magnified Area I.text: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

Magnified Area II.text: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

Maim.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.

Malady.text: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.

Mana Bounty.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.

Mana Flare.text: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to trigger a Mana Flare on Critical Hit. The Mana Flare consumes your Mana to deal Fire damage. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

Mana Leech.text: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.

Mark for Death.text: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

Mark for Death II.text: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

Mark of Siphoning.text: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

Mark of Siphoning II.text: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Life and Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

Meat Shield I.text: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Meat Shield II.text: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.

Minion Instability.text: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.

Minion Mastery.text: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Minion Pact I.text: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

Minion Pact II.text: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

Minion Splash I.text: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

Minion Splash II.text: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, increasing their Area of Effect and causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

Mobility.text: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.

Momentum.text: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.

Morgana's Tempest.text: Supports Storm skills, increasing their Limit and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.

Multishot I.text: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

Multishot II.text: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

Murderous Intent.text: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.

Muster.text: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.

Mysticism I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

Mysticism II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

Neural Overload.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.

Nimble Reload.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.

Nova Projectiles I.text: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.

Nova Projectiles II.text: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Opening Move.text: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.

Overabundance I.text: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

Overabundance II.text: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

Overcharge.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.

Overextend.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.

Overreach.text: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.

Paquate's Pact.text: Supports Warcries, Triggering Twisted Pact  to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect., at the cost of your Life.

Payload.text: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.

Perfected Endurance.text: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.

Perfection.text: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.

Perpetual Charge.text: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.

Persistent Ground I.text: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.

Persistent Ground II.text: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

Persistent Ground III.text: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.

Physical Mastery.text: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Pierce I.text: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.

Pierce II.text: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.

Pierce III.text: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.

Pin I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.

Pin II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun, as well as granting Critial Hit Chance against Immobilised enemies.

Pin III.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun. Pin buildup caused by Supported Skill is lessened, but Pin duration is significantly longer.

Pinpoint Critical.text: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.

Poison I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

Poison II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

Poison III.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.

Poison Spores.text: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.

Potent Exposure.text: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.

Practical Magic I.text: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

Practical Magic II.text: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

Practiced Combo.text: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.

Precision I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

Precision II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

Profanity I.text: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.

Profanity II.text: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.

Projectile Acceleration I.text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.

Projectile Acceleration II.text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.

Projectile Acceleration III.text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.

Projectile Deceleration I.text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

Projectile Deceleration II.text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

Prolonged Duration I.text: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

Prolonged Duration II.text: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

Punch Through.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.

Pursuit I.text: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Pursuit II.text: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Pursuit III.text: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Quill Burst.text:
Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've
Retaliated with Thorns Damage.

Rage I.text: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

Rage II.text: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

Rage III.text: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.

Rageforged I.text: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

Rageforged II.text: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

Raging Cry.text: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.

Rakiata's Flow.text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.

Rapid Attacks I.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

Rapid Attacks II.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

Rapid Attacks III.text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.

Rapid Casting I.text: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

Rapid Casting II.text: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

Rapid Casting III.text: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.

Ratha's Assault.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.

Rearm I.text: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

Rearm II.text: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

Refraction I.text: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

Refraction II.text: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

Refraction III.text: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.

Reinforced Totems I.text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

Reinforced Totems II.text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

Remnant Potency I.text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.

Remnant Potency II.text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

Remnant Potency III.text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

Rending Apex.text: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.

Retaliate I.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Retaliate II.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Retreat I.text: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Retreat II.text: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Retreat III.text: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Reverberate.text: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.

Ricochet I.text: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

Ricochet II.text: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

Rigwald's Ferocity.text: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Rip.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

Rising Tempest.text: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.

Ritualistic Curse.text: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.

Romira's Requital.text: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.

Rupture.text: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.

Rusted Spikes.text: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

Ruthless.text: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.

Sacrificial Lamb I.text: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible.

Sacrificial Lamb II.text: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.

Sacrificial Offering.text: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

Salvo.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Searing Flame I.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

Searing Flame II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

Second Wind I.text: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Second Wind II.text: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Second Wind III.text: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Selfless Remnants.text: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

Shock.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

Shock Conduction.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

Shock Conduction II.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

Shock Siphon.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

Shocking Leap.text: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

Short Fuse I.text: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

Short Fuse II.text: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

Sione's Temper.text: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.

Skittering Stone I.text: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

Skittering Stone II.text: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

Slow Potency.text: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.

Soul Drain.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.

Spar.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Spectral Volley.text: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.

Spell Cascade.text: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.

Spell Echo.text: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

Splinter Totem I.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

Splinter Totem II.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

Static Shocks.text: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.

Steadfast I.text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

Steadfast II.text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

Stoicism I.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

Stoicism II.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

Stomping Ground.text: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.

Stormchain.text: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

Stormfire.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.

Streamlined Rounds.text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

Strong Hearted.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Stun I.text: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

Stun II.text: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

Stun III.text: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.

Supercritical.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

Swift Affliction I.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

Swift Affliction II.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

Swift Affliction III.text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.

Syzygy.text: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

Tacati's Ire.text: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.

Tasalio's Rhythm.text: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.

Tawhoa's Tending.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.

Tear.text: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

Tecrod's Revenge.text: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a duration. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.

Tectonic Slams.text: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.

Thornskin I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

Thornskin II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

Thrill of the Kill.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.
