Thrill of the Kill II.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

Tireless.text: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

Tul's Stillness.text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.

Uhtred's Augury.text: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Uhtred's Exodus.text: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Uhtred's Omen.text: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Unerring Power.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

Unleash.text: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Untouchable.text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

Upheaval I.text: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.

Upheaval II.text: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.

Upwelling I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

Upwelling II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

Urgent Totems I.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

Urgent Totems II.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

Urgent Totems III.text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

Uruk's Smelting.text: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.

Uul-Netol's Embrace.text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.

Vanguard I.text: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

Vanguard II.text: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

Varashta's Blessing.text: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Verglas.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.

Vilenta's Propulsion.text: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.

Vitality I.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Vitality II.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Volatility.text: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.

Volcanic Eruption.text: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.

Volt.text: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

Vruun's Inevitability.text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Warm Blooded.text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Wildfire.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

Wildshards I.text: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

Wildshards II.text: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

Wind Wave.text: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.

Window of Opportunity I.text: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

Window of Opportunity II.text: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

Withering Touch.text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

Xibaqua's Rending.text: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

Xoph's Pyre.text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.

Zarokh's Refrain.text: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.

Zarokh's Revolt.text: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.

Zenith I.text: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Zenith II.text: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Zerphi's Infamy.text:
Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly
 increased area of effect.
